draft.subject: Your first project in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Theo,

Thanks for raising dark mode — as Tariq noted, it isn't available yet, but it's on the roadmap, and your ticket is now closed on our side.

On getting value from Wrenfield: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so one real project with your actual work is the thing that makes everything else click. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through your first project with you and answer anything else.

Best,
Priya
